statement: let W := fun (z y s : ℕ) => let P := (Finset.Ico z y).filter Nat.Prime; (2:ℤ)-((P.filter (fun p => p∣s)).card:ℤ)-((P.filter (fun p => p^2∣s)).card:ℤ); let A := fun (n z : ℕ) => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ ¬ (p ∣ n) ∧ ((Finset.Ico 2 z).filter (fun q => Nat.Prime q ∧ q ∣ (n-p))) = ∅); ∀ (n z y : ℕ), 4≤n → 2<z → z<y → let A0 := Finset.filter (fun p => 2≤n-p) (A n z); let P := (Finset.Ico z y).filter Nat.Prime; (∑ p ∈ A0, W z y (n-p)) = (2:ℤ)*(A0.card:ℤ) - (∑ q ∈ P, ((Finset.filter (fun p => q ∣ n-p) A0).card:ℤ)) - (∑ q ∈ P, ((Finset.filter (fun p => q^2 ∣ n-p) A0).card:ℤ)) ∧ (∀ q ∈ P, q ∣ n → (Finset.filter (fun p => q ∣ n-p) A0) = ∅)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖第三批 · FR-9023 · 把去掉 1 的筛和化成同一底集上的一次与平方整除计数
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage III · FR-9023 · Express the sieve sum without remainder one using first and square divisibility counts

brief.zh: 交换两次有限求和。q 整除 n 时，若也整除 n−p，素性迫使 p=q，与 p 不整除 n 矛盾。由此统一 F17–F18 的主项和误差对象。
brief.en: Exchange the two finite sums. If q divides both n and n−p, primality gives p=q, contradicting p∤n. This gives the common counting objects for F17 and F18.
